manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find a FY2026 target confirmation form from a school support page where the page text, not the PDF filename, provides the rolling-year evidence.
search_queries: 聖十字看護専門学校 令和8年度 修学支援新制度 確認申請書
聖十字看護専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
steps: Open the school disclosure page https://seijuji.jp/disclosure/.
Read the 修学支援新制度 section stating 本校は、令和8年度より高等教育の修学支援新制度における対象校となります.
Follow the adjacent anchor labeled 大学等における修学支援に関する法律第7条 第2項に掲げる要件（確認申請書様式 第2号）.
Accept it as FY2026 because the adjacent page text provides 令和8年度 target-year evidence and the PDF body contains 様式第２号 plus the school name.

reusable_rules: Treat a 修学支援新制度 section statement such as 令和8年度より対象校 as strong FY2026 evidence when it is adjacent to a 確認申請書様式 第2号 link.
Accept a stable PDF filename without a year when the adjacent page context supplies target-year evidence and the PDF body has 様式第２号 plus the school name.
Preserve the direct PDF URL and pattern_type=wordpress for the WordPress-hosted /wp-content/ PDF so future extractor changes cannot silently route this through a weaker pattern.
anti_patterns: Do not require the PDF filename itself to contain 2026 or R8 when the disclosure page supplies the rolling target-year statement.
Do not treat later board-member term dates such as 令和8年5月 inside the PDF as fiscal-year evidence by themselves.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found the adjacent 令和8年度 target-school statement and verified the PDF body contains 聖十字看護専門学校 and 様式第２号.
